id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_130.pack|cs_: "My, my, Master Rab. It has been a long time. And you've brought companions today...
"Cesar, good to see you well. Say, is Lord Jasper in? I have business with him.
"I'm afraid my master has gone to Heliodor Castle to lecture on swordsmanship and will be away for a while.
"I see, what a shame. I'd wanted to talk history and culture of various lands again after so long.
"My master was deeply impressed by your broad knowledge. He was looking forward to seeing you.
"Well then, we'll leave that for another time. Since Lord Jasper is out, I'll ask Cesar instead.
"In truth, I wish to broaden my horizons by going out to the open sea. Could you open the floodgate for me?
"Of course. If I turned down a request from you, Master Rab, my master would scold me.
"Then I'll open the floodgate, so please board your ship and wait in front of it.
"I'm much obliged, Cesar. Do give Lord Jasper my regards.
